parsed.note_claim: As of July 3, 2026, there has been no official announcement of Mitch McConnell's death and he is presumed to be alive.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On Thursday, a spokesperson said McConnell remains hospitalized. "Senator McConnell appreciates the outpouring of support he's receiving while he continues his recovery in the hospital," the spokesperson said in a statement. "The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session."
parsed.reason: The article, dated July 1-2, 2026, directly describes McConnell as alive and recovering in the hospital, substantiating the note's claim that no death had been announced and he was presumed alive as of July 3.
